_doc: OPTIONAL extras keyed by type id. Report types themselves are discovered by scanning the Basic Templates folder (/workspace/casetemplates/tools/basic_templates.py maps each file to a stable id by OneDrive item id, alias or keywords; unknown files get a slug id). Card name = file name without ' Template'. Cases are assigned by the Basic Template each case was built from. 'order' sets Home card order; unknown types go last.

histo.desc: Gross, microscopy, diagnosis; CAP synoptic for cancers

cap.desc: Cancer resections with CAP synoptic checklist

ihc.desc: IHC without images: results, scoring, controls, impression

ihc-images.desc: IHC with an images section for representative photomicrographs

ihc-breast.desc: ER, PR, HER2, Ki-67 panel with scoring (Allred, HER2) and images

fnac.desc: Palpation FNAC: site, aspirate, microscopy, impression

cyto.desc: USG/CT-guided FNAC, biliary brush, scrape and other cytology

serous.desc: Ascitic, peritoneal wash, pleural, pericardial fluid

fluid.desc: CSF, urine, BAL, synovial, cyst fluid…

bma.desc: PB findings, aspirate morphology, differential count
